title: Wave Farm Arrays 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Wave Farm Arrays 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Wave Farm Arrays 2.0 — survivable wave converters in farm formation.

Phase 1 — Prove (converter buoys): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (array logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (storm survival): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (mooring grids): array hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and coastal seas-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
